name: Hickman to Secret Wars: full
description: The complete Hickman saga including tie-ins, ending with Secret Wars (2015).

items.title: Dark Reign: The List - Secret Warriors (2009) #1
items.seriesName: Dark Reign: The List - Secret Warriors (2009)

items.title: Secret Warriors (2009) #12
items.description: WAKE THE BEAST PART 2 Nick Fury quietly moves his forces into place as the war between Leviathan and Hydra kicks into gear. Also, the long-awaited origin of the mysterious Hive and the identity of Stonewall's father revealed!

items.title: Secret Warriors (2009) #13
items.description: WAKE THE BEAST PART 3 Origins, changes and an ending! This issue has them all! The story of how Strucker and Kraken rebuilt HYDRA. Fury's new direction for the kids. And one of the team members reaches the end of the road.

items.title: Secret Warriors (2009) #14
items.description: WAKE THE BEAST PART 4 The secret history of Contessa Valentina Allegra de Fontaine: How did Nick Fury's significant other end up working for the hated HYDRA and what's the even more sinister dark secret buried deep in her past?

items.title: Secret Warriors (2009) #16
items.description: WAKE THE BEAST CONCLUSION Leviathan and Hydra go to war. A betrayal from deep within Fury's organization. More clues to the Zodiac event. And the final fate of the man called Kraken.

items.title: Siege: Secret Warriors (2010) #1
items.description: During the battle at Asgard, the Sentry - under command of Norman Osborn - killed Ares. Now Phobos must avenge his fallen father, begging the question: will any survive his vengeance?

items.title: Secret Warriors (2009) #17
items.description: THE LAST RIDE OF THE HOWLING COMMANDOS PART 1 Relive the glory days of WWII during the reunion of Steve Rogers, Nick Fury and the remaining members of the US's most elite Special Unit from the Greatest Generation!

items.title: Secret Warriors (2009) #18
items.description: THE LAST RIDE OF THE HOWLING COMMANDOS PART 2 The reunion dinner between Nick Fury and his World War II brothers in arms continues against the backdrop of a suicide mission deep within enemy territory.

items.title: Secret Warriors (2009) #19
items.description: THE LAST RIDE OF THE HOWLING COMMANDOS CONCLUSION See Steve Rogers and the Howling Commandos kick some tail during WWII!

items.title: Secret Warriors (2009) #25
items.description: WHEELS WITHING WHEELS PART 2 What ties Hydra, The Howling Commandos, and Leviathan together? How did Nick Fury, Dum Dum Dugan, Baron Von Strucker, Kraken and Orion become part of the same mysterious organization?

items.title: Secret Warriors (2009) #26
items.description: WHEELS WITHIN WHEELS PART 3 Two men in a room. The history of Hydra, the history of S.H.I.E.LD.

items.title: Secret Warriors (2009) #27
items.description: WHEELS WITHIN WHEELS PART 4 The penultimate issues of Secret Warriors!

items.title: Secret Warriors (2009) #28
items.description: WHEELS WITHIN WHEELS PART 5 Series finale! What will happen to Nick Fury? Who lives? Who dies? What is the stunning new direction for the remnants of S.H.I.E.L.D. in the Marvel Universe?

items.title: Fantastic Four (1998) #570
items.description: The First Issue of Jonathan Hickman's run on Fantastic Four.  It's adventure, it's family, it's tough questions in dark times...See what happens when Reed Richards tries to SOLVE EVERYTHING.

items.title: Fantastic Four (1998) #575
items.description: PRIME ELEMENTS PART 1 Witness the return of the Mole Man and see the Fantastic Four discover the world's smartest Moloid!

items.title: Fantastic Four (1998) #576
items.description: PRIME ELEMENTS PART 2 The Fantastic Four head to the bottom of the world to discover the mystery of the Vostok Station!

items.title: Fantastic Four (1998) #577
items.description: PRIME ELEMENTS PART 3 The Fantastic Four delve into the past of the Inhumans! Behold, the Universal Inhumans!

items.title: Fantastic Four (1998) #587
items.description: THREE PART 5 This is the penultimate chapter of THREE! Which member of the Fantastic Four will perish?

items.title: FF (2011) #5
items.description: The mystery that is...Medusa!

items.title: FF (2011) #6
items.description: The return of the king! Black Bolt is back and determined to reclaim his throne.

items.title: FF (2011) #7
items.description: At what ends will Black Bolt go to in order to become king of the Inhumans once again? And will the prophecies of the War of Four Cities come to pass?

items.title: FF (2011) #8
items.description: The War of Four Cities escalates and we learn what it is that Marvel's First Family fears most!

items.title: FF (2011) #9
items.description: The Future Foundation is caught in the middle of the War of Four Cities. Watch as the war expands to encompass the entire Marvel Universe!

items.title: FF (2011) #10
items.description: Ben Grimm returns as Ronan the Accuser and the armies of the Kree Empire invade the Earth!

items.title: FF (2011) #11
items.description: A galactic empire is born as the War of Four Cities comes to a close. What does it mean for Marvel's First Family?

items.title: Fantastic Four (1998) #600
items.description: FOREVER PART 1 The 50th anniversary issue of the Fantastic Four! Joins us for the epic celebration of Marvel's First Family with 96 pages of all-new content!

items.title: Fantastic Four (1998) #601
items.description: FOREVER PART 2 Finally, It's Clobberin' Time.

items.title: FF (2011) #13
items.description: ALL HOPE LIES IN DOOM PART 2 The Battle between the Council of Reeds and the Future Foundation extends through the Bridge and into the world now controlled by the Mad Celestials.

items.title: Fantastic Four (1998) #602
items.description: FOREVER PART 3 The Kree Empire vs. the Annihilation Wave, with Earth's heroes in the middle! And Galactus returns to judge the world!

items.title: FF (2011) #14
items.description: ALL HOPE LIES IN DOOM PART 3 "Help me Doctor Doom, you're my only hope."

items.title: Fantastic Four (1998) #603
items.description: FOREVER PART 4 It's Galactus versus the Celestials! Plus, the return of the Future Foundation!

items.title: FF (2011) #15
items.description: The final chapter for the Council of Reeds! Guest-starring the Power Pack!

items.title: FF (2011) #17
items.description: Now that he's back among the living, the Human Torch moves in with Spider-Man! Can two superheroes share an apartment without driving each other crazy?

items.title: FF (2011) #18
items.description: "The Future Foundation kids take their first Field Trip -- to the Negative Zone. See what happens when Annihilus goes home. Plus, the return of Future Franklin and Val."

items.title: Fantastic Four (1998) #607
items.description: "The Fantastic Four travel to Wakanda, which means the return of Black Panther to the pages of Fantastic Four. Their mission: what happens when the world completely runs out of Vibranium?"

items.title: FF (2011) #19
items.description: The kids take their second Field Trip -- To Africa! Meet the Science Club of Wakanda. And the Future Foundation gets a brand new member.

items.title: Fantastic Four (1998) #608
items.description: The Nation of Wakanda is set on a path that will forever change its role in the Marvel Universe. The Panther God chooses the fate of T'Challa. Who will be the Black Panther?

items.title: Fantastic Four (1998) #609
items.description: The Defenders from the Future hope to set out on the adventure of a lifetime, and only the Fantastic Four can help them get there.

items.title: FF (2011) #21
items.description: In a move that surprises everyone, Black Bolt and the Inhumans return to Earth. What does this mean for Marvel's first family?

items.title: Fantastic Four (1998) #610
items.description: Crossing over with FF #22, the Fantastic Four must deal with the fallout of the Wizard returning to claim his son - Future Foundation member Bentley 23!

items.title: FF (2011) #22
items.description: Concluding the crossover with FF #610, witness the fallout of Bentley 23's reunion with his father, the Wizard. It's Bad Father, Worse Son.

items.title: Fantastic Four (1998) #611
items.description: Jonathan Hickman's groundbreaking run comes to an end in this climactic issue!

items.title: FF (2011) #23
items.description: Old Franklin teaches Young Franklin ?How to Be a God!?

items.title: Ultimate Fallout (2011) #1
items.description: Following the tragic events of DEATH OF SPIDER-MAN, prepare for the birth of the new Ultimate Comics Universe.

items.title: Ultimate Fallout (2011) #2
items.description: DEATH OF SPIDER-MAN has sent shockwaves throughout the Ultimate Universe. Find out what happens next!

items.title: Ultimate Fallout (2011) #3
items.description: Witness the fate of the Ultimate Comics Universe after DEATH OF SPIDER-MAN.

items.title: Ultimate Fallout (2011) #4
items.description: Witness the fallout of DEATH OF SPIDER-MAN and the birth of the new ULTIMATE COMCIS UNIVERSE.

items.title: Ultimate Fallout (2011) #5
items.description: In the penultimate chapter of FALLOUT, the fate of the Ultimate Comics Universe takes shape. Who are the heroes of this new age? Which villains lie in the shadows, waiting for the moment to strike?

items.title: Ultimate Fallout (2011) #6
items.description: The final chapter of FALLOUT is here! Prepare for the new ULTIMATE COMICS universe!

items.title: Ultimate Comics Ultimates (2011) #1
items.description: The next era has begun. As they struggle to find their place in the world, the The Ultimates face game-changing threats even they can't handle. And with the heart of the team missing in action, the country's last stand of defense may be on its last legs.

items.title: Ultimate Comics Ultimates (2011) #3
items.description: The Children of Tomorrow have transformed the Norse Gods into mortal men! Now, depowered and on the verge of utter destruction, the only hope the Pantheon has lies with Nick Fury and his Ultimates!

items.title: Ultimate Comics Ultimates (2011) #5
items.description: Tomorrow's Children are in control! All hope looks lost for Thor and the Ultimates! The Children's creator has revealed his sinister connection to the Ultimate Universe!

items.title: Ultimate Comics Ultimates (2011) #6
items.description: Ultimate Falcon makes his triumphant return! And Nick Fury turns to the one man who can save the Ultimates!

items.title: Ultimate Comics Ultimates (2011) #7
items.description: The Ultimates deal with the fallout of the new world! Meanwhile, an old friend returns! After all this, can Nick Fury pick up the pieces of his broken team?

items.title: Ultimate Comics Ultimates (2011) #10
items.description: In the aftermath of the People vs. the Children, how will Nick Fury and his team of Ultimates move forward?

items.title: Ultimate Comics Ultimates (2011) #11
items.description: The Nimrod Fleet continues their brutal massacre of mutants, Stryker is reborn and the face of the United States is changed forever.

items.title: Ultimate Comics Hawkeye (2011) #1
items.description: Clint Barton, the hero known as Hawkeye, is back and on a mission! Prepare for Hawkeye's climactic return to the Ultimate Comics Universe in the beginning of this pulse-pounding series!

items.title: Ultimate Comics Hawkeye (2011) #2
items.description: Hawkeye finds himself in the middle of an international arms race where the stakes are higher than ever. At the fringe of obtaining a serum that will change the course of mutant history, has the eagle-eyed hero aimed too high to succeed?

items.title: Ultimate Comics Hawkeye (2011) #3
items.description: Nick Fury has sent Hawkeye on a vital international mission. But with no backup to be had, Clint Barton may find himself on the losing end of a major battle - until Fury sends in unexpected reinforcements: a covert mutant team and The Hulk!

items.title: Ultimate Comics Hawkeye (2011) #4
items.description: A newly-developed mutant-serum puts the world on the brink of war! Caught in the international conflict, Hawkeye is outnumbered with all odds against - just as he likes it! If Hawkeye can't save world, then who can?

items.title: Avengers (2012) #1
items.description: Marvel Now! adds new faces to Earth's mightiest team of superheroes! The Avengers expand their roster and sphere of influence to a global - and even interplanetary - level!

items.title: Avengers (2012) #2
items.description: The greatest heroes in comics together on one unbeatable team! Now shipping twice a month, the Avengers "go large," expanding their roster and their sphere of influence to a global and even interplanetary level. When Captain America puts out his call - who will answer? Big threats, big ideas, big idealism - these are the Avengers NOW!

items.title: Avengers (2012) #3
items.description: The New Adam is born! And on Mars, the battle between the Avengers and the Garden comes to its dramatic conclusion!

items.title: Avengers (2012) #4
items.description: The Secret Origin of Hyperion. The Legacy of the Garden unfolds in the Savage Land. "We'll have to field test our theories here. NOW." --Dr. Deeds

items.title: Avengers (2012) #5
items.description: Meet Smasher, the first human member of the IMPERIAL GUARD and an Avenger. Watch as the Avengers travel across the galaxy to fight off an invading force. Watch as the Imperial Guard are broken on a dead moon.

items.title: Avengers (2012) #6
items.description: "GODDESS." The Secret Origin of the Universe. Watch as for the first time in history, The UNIVERSE becomes sentient. Watch as Captain Universe deciphers the code that was hidden in the first five issues.

items.title: Avengers (2012) #7
items.description: "WORLD BREAKER." The Avengers must scramble to deal with the threat of another Universal SYSTEM. The New Adam is transformed, and his true self revealed. And the most dangerous hero on Earth is created.

items.title: Avengers (2012) #8
items.description: "SYSTEM FAILURE." The Avengers face off against the World Breaker. Discover the imminent threat to the Avengers World. Watch as we get our first hints as the hidden connections between the events of Avengers and New Avengers.

items.title: Avengers (2012) #9
items.description: "NEW UNIVERSE." Watch as the most dangerous weapon in the Universe is unleashed. Two Universal SYSTEMS collide. What good is a White Event if only leads to the destruction of the planet it was meant to transform?

items.title: Avengers (2012) #10
items.description: "VALIDATOR." We learn that the Canadian super team Omega Flight got lost in a Garden Origin Site. Discover what happens when the Avengers go in to rescue them. Learn why ADAPTATION is the scariest word in the Marvel Universe.

items.title: Avengers (2012) #11
items.description: "WAKE THE DRAGON." As Shang-Chi battles an ancient enemy, the Avengers hang out in Hong Kong's swankiest casino. Captain Marvel, Black Widow and Spider-Woman find out it doesn't pay to gamble in the spy business. Cannonball and Sunspot play craps with a bunch of AIM Agents. AND WIN!

items.title: Avengers (2012) #12
items.description: "CHILDREN OF THE SUN." A day in the life of the Avengers...in the Savage Land. The boys go hunting for dinosaurs and end up catching something else entirely. Hyperion and Captain Universe begin the godlike education of the transformed Savage Land children.

items.title: Avengers (2012) #13
items.description: The High Evolutionary stakes his claim on the Children of the Sun. Hyperion learns the true cost of the decisions he's made at the Origin Site in the Savage Land. The Return of techno-titan Terminus.

items.title: Avengers (2012) #14
items.description: "THE SIGNAL." Prelude to Infinity. All of the Origin Sites go active as the Earth begins to communicate with something much more ancient than human civilizations. The Terror scientists of A.I.M. unveil the S7 program. Prelude to INFINITY: Part One.

items.title: Avengers (2012) #15
items.description: "ECHO TERRA" Prelude to INFINITY: Part Two. Aliens races fleeing an intergalactic terror crash to Earth, just as the Avengers are occupied with the now-active Origin Sites! Captain Universe and Manifold take a trip across the universe.

items.title: Avengers (2012) #16
items.description: "THE TWO WORLDS SOLUTION" Prelude to INFINITY: Part Three. The battle between the Avengers and Mad Earth heats up. Whatever happened to Ex Nihilo and Abyss, and for that matter, Starbrand and Nightmask as well?

items.title: Avengers (2012) #17
items.description: "ALL QUIET." The Avengers recruit more members to deal with the soon-arriving threat to Earth. The Builders enter the Marvel Universe. The Finale of the Prelude to INFINITY: Part Four.

items.title: Avengers (2012) #18
items.description: "AVENGERS UNIVERSE." Deep in space, the Avengers join the Council of Worlds as they declare war on their cosmic invaders. The rebirth of the Skrull Empire. The first encounter with the Builders.

items.title: Avengers (2012) #19
items.description: INFINITY TIE-IN "AVENGERS UNIVERSE: II." The Avengers, prisoners of war! One last desperate plan. Betrayal in the Galactic Council.

items.title: Avengers (2012) #20
items.description: INFINITY TIE-IN "AVENGERS UNIVERSE: III" Unexpected overtures from the Builders. A meeting of Ex Nihilos. Total, unconditional surrender.

items.title: Avengers (2012) #21
items.description: INFINITY TIE-IN "AVENGERS UNIVERSE: IV." The final battle for the Marvel universe begins. The fall of a Galactic empire. The rise of a new one.

items.title: Avengers (2012) #22
items.description: INFINITY TIE-IN "AVENGERS UNIVERSE: V." The Avengers return to our Solar System. The battle for Earth starts in the heavens. The Black Order makes their move.

items.title: Avengers (2012) #23
items.description: INFINITY TIE-IN "AVENGERS UNIVERSE: VI." The Avengers versus the Black Order. The battle for Earth moves planetside. Thanos takes center stage.

items.title: Avengers (2012) #24
items.description: "ROGUE PLANET" - Part 1 of 5. Captain America and Iron Man plan for the next version of the Avengers. A runaway planet is on a collision course with Earth. A visitor from the future helps save the day. AVENGERS #24.NOW = AVENGERS #1 IN ALL-NEW MARVEL NOW!

items.title: Avengers (2012) #25
items.description: "THE MIRROR." It worked for the X-Men! Would we be so crass as to do it again? Introducing the ALL-NEW AVENGERS! And we've been good up till now, but this issue, an Avenger dies.

items.title: Avengers (2012) #26
items.description: "ADAPT OR DIE." The science war overtakes the world(s). The All-New Avengers Strike Back! All the answers to the questions you wished remained hidden. The collision of Avengers and New Avengers is imminent.

items.title: Avengers (2012) #27
items.description: ADAPT OR DIE. The secret behind the All-New Avengers revealed! The science war overtakes the world(s). All the answers to the questions you wished remained hidden. The collision of Avengers and New Avengers is imminent.

items.title: Avengers (2012) #28
items.description: A challenge twenty-eight issues in the making, as Bruce Banner puts the pieces together and confronts Iron Man?

items.title: Avengers (2012) #29
items.description: WHAT DID HE SEE?

items.title: Avengers (2012) #30
items.description: Now that Captain America knows he was betrayed, how will this affect the Avengers and the secret Illuminati?

items.title: Avengers (2012) #31
items.description: ORIGINAL SIN tie-in! Propelled fifty years into the future, the Avengers come face-to-face with the legacy of their actions!

items.title: Avengers (2012) #32
items.description: ORIGINAL SIN tie-in! 5000 years into the future. Rogue Planet redux: The mysterious origin of the rogue planet revealed.

items.title: Avengers (2012) #33
items.description: ORIGINAL SIN tie-in! 50,000 years into the future. Holoworld: Earth's Mightiest Heroes captured in conceptual space. How do you defeat an idea?

items.title: Avengers (2012) #34
items.description: ORIGINAL SIN tie-in! "THIS PROBLEM OF AVENGERS." The first Avenger meets the last Avenger...And the Avengers World crumbles. You won't believe what comes next.

items.title: Avengers (2012) #35
items.description: Extra-sized issue! IN 8 MONTHS...TIME RUNS OUT!

items.description: In 7 months... time runs out!

items.description: In 7 months... time runs out!

items.description: In 6 months... time runs out!

items.description: In 2 months... time runs out!

items.title: Avengers (2012) #44
items.description: Final issue!

items.title: Avengers (2012) #34.1
items.description: Last son of a dead utopia. Father-figure to a new species of humanity. Avenger. Hyperion is all these things... and more! Now the Man From Nowhere searches for an unhinged cop killer, a kidnapped child...and the answers to the questions that haunt him.

items.title: Avengers (2012) #34.2
items.description: The god-like STARBRAND is losing his grip on his humanity! Can NIGHTMASK bring him back to Earth? And as our planetary defense, we need STARBRAND more than ever! Feel the heat of KOLOBUS...a cosmic threat powerful enough to burn us all down!

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #1
items.description: To prevent a collision of universes, the Illuminati must assemble NOW! Led by the Black Panther, the most powerful and brilliant team in the Marvel Universe is up against an infinite legion of parallel realities!

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #2
items.description: The Illuminati gather to plan for the death of everything. Infinity gems, old wounds, lies, agendas and universal incursions are all on the agenda!

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #3
items.description: "INFINITY" The Illuminati experience their first incursion since reforming. Can the loose brotherhood of end times trust each other enough to use the Infinity Gems in unison? And a new member joins the Illuminati!

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #4
items.description: "WORLD EATER" The Illuminati have learned that Earth is the center point for the death of the Universe. If this is true, doesn't that mean destroying it might save everything else? Enter the world eater, Galactus.

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #5
items.description: "BLACK SWAN." Learn the history of the enigmatic Black Swan. What answers can she provide the Illuminati? And watch as the New Avengers do the unthinkable!

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #6
items.description: Using the knowledge gained from the Black Swan, the Illuminati rework all their plans and cross the uncrossable line. The first secret alliance is formed. If an incursion is normally RED, what does a BLUE one mean?

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #7
items.description: The cold war between Atlantis and Wakanda heats up. Who is the secret member of the Illuminati that many of the members do not know about? How does Black Bolt lie?

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #8
items.description: "LORDS OF CHAOS." As casualties pile up in the ongoing war between Wakanda and Atlantis, an Illuminati member is forced to make a hard choice. An Inhuman learns of the Illuminati's plans. Prelude to INFINITY: Everything falls apart.

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #9
items.description: "CULL OBSIDIAN." The Illuminati on the front line as the Earth is invaded. The House of Black Bolt cracks. Earth falls.

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #10
items.description: Inhuman secrets reveal the desires of Thanos. The machinations of Maximus the Mad. The battle for Earth continues?what an awful time for an incursion.

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #11
items.description: INFINITY TIE-IN - ""BUILDING WORLDS."" The Illuminati travel to another Earth during an incursion. Thanos in Necropolis. The Builders on Earth.

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #12
items.description: INFINITY TIE-IN - ""THE WORLD WE HAVE." The House of Black Bolt crumbles. New friends, new enemies.

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #13
items.description: INHUMANITY TIE-IN! "THE OTHER SIDE." With the consequences of Infinity fresh on their minds, tough decisions are made. The gathering of a new Illuminati. We learn more about the other beings related to the Incursions.

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #14
items.description: The secret of the Black Swan?

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #15
items.description: Meet the Mapmakers, cartographers of the Apocalypse. Doctor Strange sells his soul. Reed Richards and the Illuminati rekindle an old relationship.

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #16
items.description: "THE NIGHT BEFORE THE WORLD ENDED." No more bloodshed. To save their nations, the proud Black Panther and the arrogant Namor have sued for peace. As members of the Illuminati, the secret organization made up of the Marvel Universe's most powerful heroes, they must work together to stop the extinction of the entire universe! But are their amends too little too late? There's no turning back for the Illuminati after this issue--and they'll pay the price for their sins.

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #17
items.description: Must the New Avengers destroy a perfect world so that the Earth can live?

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #18
items.description: In all of creation, only one Earth has successfully met and triumphed over each Incursion that has threatened it: the Earth of the heroes of the Great Society! Guess which Earth is on a collision course with ours?

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #19
items.description: It's the battle you didn't know you wanted to see-until now! As the New Avengers take on the combined power of the Great Society-and only a single parallel Earth can survive!

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #20
items.description: How far is Doctor Strange willing to go to protect the Earth from the Great Society? Too far?

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #21
items.description: A world must die! But which New Avenger will find the strength to press the button? And what will come in the aftermath?

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #22
items.description: "THIS IS THE VERY END?" The Illuminati shatters under an exploding planet.

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #23
items.description: "OF ALL THAT WE ONCE WERE."" We follow the members of the now-broken Illuminati through their last day on Earth.

items.title: New Avengers (2013) #24
items.description: Extra-sized issue! IN 8 MONTHS?TIME RUNS OUT!

items.title: Infinity (2013) #1
items.description: The oversized kickoff to the year's most anticipate Blockbuster summer event, chaning the way you view the Marvel Universe! The outbreak of war on two fronts: Earth and Space, with our heroes torn between them. The world-shattering return of Thanos! Includes material from FREE COMIC BOOK DAY: INFINITY.

items.title: Infinity (2013) #2
items.description: The Inhumans pay the tribute. Victory in deep space. The secrets of Thanos.

items.title: Infinity (2013) #3
items.description: Prison break. Stealing a worldkiller. The fall of Attilan.

items.title: Infinity (2013) #4
items.description: Negotiating the fall of worlds. The Illuminati versus Thanos. Thor, God of War.

items.title: Infinity (2013) #5
items.description: The Avengers Universe. The Heroes of Earth rally to defeat Thanos. The war for Earth begins.

items.title: Infinity (2013) #6
items.description: All roads lead to this! The over-sized conclusion of the Marvel Summer event! The heroes of Earth versus the forces of Thanos!

items.title: FREE COMIC BOOK DAY 2015 0 (2015)
items.description: This May, prepare yourself for the kickoff of the biggest comic event in Marvel history, with a special preview of Marvel's future in Secret Wars #0!

items.title: Secret Wars (2015) #1
items.description: The Final Incursion is happening! The Marvel Universe is colliding with the Ultimate Universe! And neither will survive!

items.title: Secret Wars (2015) #2
items.description: When the Marvel Universe is gone, all that remains is Battleworld! Learn the secrets of this brave new realm in this special oversized issue!

items.title: Secret Wars (2015) #3
items.description: All the Devils dance!

items.title: Secret Wars (2015) #4
items.description: ALL THE ANGELS SING

items.title: Secret Wars (2015) #5
items.description: Owen Reece died for our sins!

items.title: Secret Wars (2015) #6
items.description: The Final War!

items.title: Secret Wars (2015) #7
items.description: The Greatest Sacrifice!

items.title: Secret Wars (2015) #8
items.description: Genesis!

items.title: Secret Wars (2015) #9
items.description: Genesis!
